receipt.public_excerpt: NemoClaw is an alpha project, so maintainers review issues, discussions, and pull requests on a best effort basis without guaranteed response timelines.

evidence_items.explanation: Shows NemoClaw is still an alpha reference stack. This is background on its maturity. It does not measure impact or show whether Nvidia 'often' releases low-impact software.

unresolved_gaps: No independent, dated data on how many organisations use NemoClaw.
Third-party GitHub star counts for NemoClaw disagree (about 14,600 to 22,700), and no benchmark says whether that is 'little'.
No defined set of other Nvidia software announcements to test 'often' against.
